mechanism: Valerian may potentiate serotonergic and sedative effects of phenelzine (MAOI), and phenelzine may inhibit valerian metabolism via CYP3A4/CYP2D6, increasing valerian levels and CNS depression risk.
action: Avoid concurrent use or monitor closely for excessive sedation, serotonin syndrome symptoms, and hypertensive episodes; consider alternative anxiolytic agents.
